reports.desc:
Hi, this website is pretending to be cracker barrel and it is in fact not cracker barrel. They probably stole my card info, so trying to get them shut down or warn others. The site had no warning, was promoted on google shopping, and is a complete scam. Hope this helps other gullible people stay away from them

https://crackerbarreell.online
Ordered a 24 pair pack of ice silk pants size 2xl was taken amount of 41.95 was taken out of my bank account by this company and i have never received the product

I received the attached letter.  I did call them because I did have a warranty I needed to call and activate, and I thought this was related to that.  After speaking with the gentleman there, he seemed fishy.  When I said that I didn't want to share information, he asked why and I told him I was skeptical of people asking for information.  He began to laugh and said he didn't understand and rattled off a bunch of information about our vehicle and loan, our address, etc - and said if he wanted to do anything harmful he could simply come to our home and do it. After that he said fine, have a good day and I hung up.
I ordered 4 bras when i got them they were way to big.  When i asked to reopen them i was told i could not but for an additional $40 they would send another size

My debit card was entered in a google acct that doesn't belong to me or my home address. The charged my card back to back within 2 minutes. I reached out my bank as well as the vendor to provide documentation for me giving this authorization and each company was unable to but told.me the charges are legit which is a lie. This is not my acct nor dis i approve for any roblox charges to be made on my acct.

Submitted an online order for two items: Crossbody, black bag, and Birkenstock sandals. The Crossbody received was a different color and the Birkenstock sandals were damaged and not able to be used. Tried to submit a return request via the chat function on the Zulily website as well as contacting customer service via email. The saved responses from Zulily directed me to submit a refund request online through their refund function on their website. That function has not, and is still not, available. I have gone without a refund for more than four months.
Saying I was approved for GLP-1 when I never requested it nor need it and I don’t know a care coordinator name Owen

Company promised delivery/shipment of said product (herbal diffuser inhaler) to help quit smoking..never delivered product,kept giving excuses why wasn't delivered,won't give refund when asked for, keeps saying is going to be delivered .have had contact on ******** with many upon many other people who have been decived and had lost money from same companies...

Company sent me a "check" for $4983.67 with instructions to deposit it and keep $750 for my part and pay the decal installer $4050.   The check was drawn on "Bank of America" for the company FM COnstructors LLC. at 100 DR MLK JR BLVD, East Orange, NJ 07018.   The routing number was NOT a Bank of America routing number.   I burned it in the backyard.

Scammer sent me a letter stating that my home warranty was about to expire and I had one last chance to renew it. They listed the bank I had my mortgage with and my home address. I have never had home warranty coverage

Offered a home job assembling product but ended up doing tasks till my shipment arrived. At first it seemed legit. But then tgey would add on another task to do and if you didnt complete it you lost your money. Never was told ahead of time about a second task. Just out of the blue popped that on you to press you for more money involved. Never got my money back. Never got my bonuses ether.
PayPal is covering for this furdulent company.
As I was checking my bank account transactions, I noticed that an unauthorized debit was conducted on September 16, 2026, at 3:19 p.m.

They call relentlessly at least 5 times a day from different number every time same prerecorded message saying I am pre approved for a loan that I applied for which I have not recording states it is Blake Armstrong and to call another number or press 2 as soon as you ask them to remove from there call list they hang up it’s getting so bad I Amy have to change my phone number as again they call at least 5 times a day while I am working and when I am not
